source: Mike's family tree (GEDCOM), a secondary source built from research. Census returns are the evidence.

people.name: Andrew Gillespie
notes: Father of Bridget Gillespie. Birth year ~1816 confirmed by 1901 census - exact match with tree. Irish and English speaker. Confirmed in Druminardagh at Griffith's date (~1857) with house, office and land under lessor James Hamilton. Present in 1901 census at Druminardagh with wife Catherine McAnaw and son Edward. Absent from 1911 census - deceased by then. Son Edward Gillespie remained in Druminardagh through 1926.

people.name: Catherine McAnaw
notes: Wife of Andy Gillespie. Maiden name McAnaw - from the Druminnin McAnaw cluster, same family as Mary McAna (, wife of Hugh McGettigan). The precise relationship between Catherine McAnaw and Mary McAna requires further research into pre-census records. Both being McAnaw women connected to this community and sharing the Druminnin origin strongly suggests they were related - possibly sisters. Surname variants: McAnaw, McNaw, McNan, McKenna. Irish and English speaker.

people.name: Edward Gillespie
notes: Son of Andy Gillespie and Catherine McAnaw. Brother of Bridget Gillespie. Remained in Druminardagh through 1901, 1911 and 1926 census returns. Married Lizzie (surname unknown) - married 7 years in 1911 census.

family_notes: Marriage predates civil registration (1864). Both present in 1901 census at Druminardagh, both absent by 1911.
